quest.heading: QUESTS
quest.getting_started.title: Getting Started
quest.getting_started.description: Learn the essentials of life in the prehistoric grasslands.
quest.sand_land.title: Sand Land
quest.sand_land.description: Survive hunger, thirst, and rival dinosaurs in the scorching desert.
mission.dinner_time.title: Dinner Time
mission.dinner_time.intro: Dinner time! You are a hungry Triceratops. Find and eat two plants to complete your first mission.
mission.explore_the_world.title: Explore the World
mission.explore_the_world.intro: Explore the world! Travel across the valley and uncover the entire map.
mission.family.title: Family
mission.family.description: Find a Triceratops pack and stay with it for 3 minutes.
mission.family.intro: Find your family! Locate the Triceratops herd and stay close to them for three minutes.
mission.breed.title: Breed
mission.breed.description: Find two eggs and hatch both children. Keep them safe.
mission.breed.intro: Help the next generation! Find two dinosaur eggs, hatch both babies, and keep them safe.
mission.hunt.title: Hunt
mission.hunt.description: Find prey, kill it, and eat the meat.
mission.hunt.intro: The hunt begins! Track down the marked prey, defeat it, and eat the meat.
mission.defense.title: Defense
mission.defense.description: Defend your Stegosaurus pack from a Velociraptor.
mission.defense.intro: Protect your herd! A Velociraptor is attacking. Defeat it before any Stegosaurus is lost.
mission.poison.title: Poison
mission.poison.description: Eat poisonous food, then find a cure before you die.
mission.poison.intro: Poison! As a Parasaurolophus, find and eat the glowing poisonous plant. Then reach a red health token and cure yourself before it is too late.
mission.water.title: Water
mission.water.description: Lead your herd safely to the oasis and drink.
mission.water.intro: Your herd is thirsty. Lead five Parasaurolophus and two children across the desert to the oasis. Avoid the T-Rex hunters, then hold Eat at the water to drink.
mission.prey.title: Prey
mission.prey.description: Kill the herd leader before it reaches the oasis.
mission.prey.intro: Now you are the hunter. Chase the Parasaurolophus herd and kill its leader before it escapes to the water.
mission.kingpin.title: Kingpin
mission.kingpin.description: Defend your waterhole against a rival T-Rex.
mission.kingpin.intro: This oasis is your territory. A rival T-Rex has come to claim it. Defeat the rival and remain king of the waterhole.
mission.lost_baby.title: Lost Baby
mission.lost_baby.description: Find the lost Apatosaurus baby before the raptors do.
mission.lost_baby.intro: A baby Apatosaurus is lost among the desert rocks. Find the child before the searching Velociraptor pack catches it.
mission.eat_the_baby.title: Eat the Baby
mission.eat_the_baby.description: Find and eat the lost baby before its herd rescues it.
mission.eat_the_baby.intro: Lead your three Velociraptors to the lost Apatosaurus baby. Kill and eat it before the Apatosaurus herd arrives to rescue it.

guide.text:
[b]MOVEMENT AND ACTIONS[/b]
Drag the right-hand movement wheel in any direction to combine forward/backward movement and steering. Use the left-hand buttons to jump, run, duck, attack, eat, or scream. Keyboard controls are WASD/arrows, Space, Shift, C/Ctrl, F, E, and R.

[b]HEALTH, ENERGY, AND FOOD[/b]
Every action costs energy; running, jumping, and fighting cost more. At zero energy, health starts to fall. Herbivores regain energy by holding EAT near plants. Avoid the glowing purple plants: eating one causes continuous poison damage until a red health token cures it. Carnivores eat meat left by defeated dinosaurs. Red tokens restore health and cure poison; blue and orange tokens temporarily double speed or strength.

[b]WILDLIFE[/b]
Herbivores travel in moving packs. They flee hunters, but fight back and defend members of their own species. A matching herbivore player can shelter with a pack. A herbivore scream calls nearby members of the same species together to defend you; a predator scream frightens prey and scatters its pack. Carnivores stalk prey, avoid fights they are unlikely to win, feed after a kill, and retreat when badly injured. Dinosaurs never attack their own species.

[b]EGGS AND BABIES[/b]
Egg nests are hidden throughout the valley. Stand over an egg and hold DUCK until it hatches. The baby matches your species, follows beside you, and has its own health. When you eat, your children gather around the same food and eat with you. Protect them from predators.

[b]EXPLORING THE WORLD[/b]
Trees, rocks, fallen logs, hills, and raised ledges are solid. Rivers and lakes divide the forest and grassland areas. Invisible walls keep dinosaurs inside the valley. The minimap reveals terrain as you explore, marks predators red and herbivores green, and marks meat from defeated dinosaurs. Each herbivore pack uses one green marker.

[b]MAP TOPICS[/b]
Choose Grassland, Desert, Winter, or Volcano in Free Game. Desert vegetation clusters around scarce water holes. Winter water is frozen and every moving dinosaur leaves tracks in the snow. Volcano maps contain an erupting central mountain and glowing lava streams; touching lava continuously damages health.

[b]WORLD SEEDS[/b]
The six-digit seed and selected map topic control the complete layout. Reuse both to replay the same world or generate a new random seed.

quest.frozen_pass.title: Beyond the Frozen Pass
quest.frozen_pass.description: Follow an ancient trail through snow and ice to a warm valley beyond the mountains.
mission.tracks_in_snow.title: Tracks in the Snow
mission.tracks_in_snow.description: Follow the forward footprints through three junctions to the mountain camp.
mission.tracks_in_snow.intro: Snow has buried the old mountain trail. Follow the footprints pointing forward, past three junctions. Tracks that curl around lead back. Find the abandoned camp and the way into the mountains.
mission.whiteout.title: Whiteout
mission.whiteout.description: Reach three shelters. Wait for calm wind and keep warm under cover.
mission.whiteout.intro: A blizzard is coming! The rock shelters will keep you warm. Wait under cover while the wind howls, then move to the next shelter when it calms. Reach all three shelters to cross the snowy pass.
mission.singing_lake.title: The Singing Lake
mission.singing_lake.description: Cross four thick ice islands. Leave creaking ice before it breaks.
mission.singing_lake.intro: The frozen lake sings and creaks beneath your feet. Dark blue ice is thick and safe. Pale cracked ice will not hold you for long. Cross the four safe islands to reach the far shore. If you slip, you can try again from your last island.
mission.sleeping_giants.title: Let Sleeping Giants Lie
mission.sleeping_giants.description: Pass three sleeping giants. Walk softly on snow and stop when they stir.
mission.sleeping_giants.intro: Three enormous dinosaurs are sleeping in this quiet ravine. Soft snow muffles your footsteps, but the blue ice is noisy. Walk slowly, avoid the ice, and stop if a giant stirs. Reach the far end without waking them.
mission.snowplug.title: The Snowplug
mission.snowplug.description: Push three boulders into the blue channels, then pass through the melted opening.
mission.snowplug.intro: A mountain tunnel is plugged with snow. A little stream could melt it, if only the water flowed the right way. Stand behind each boulder and gently push it onto its blue channel marker. When all three channels are ready, follow the stream through the opening.
mission.last_avalanche.title: The Last Avalanche
mission.last_avalanche.description: Cross three avalanche slopes using rocky cover, then reach the warm valley.
mission.last_avalanche.intro: The warm valley is just ahead! But snow is sliding down the mountainside. Watch the slopes: amber means a slide is coming, red means take cover, and blue means it is safe to move. Reach each rocky checkpoint, then make your way into the green valley.

quest.heart_of_volcano.title: Heart of the Volcano
quest.heart_of_volcano.description: Six dinosaurs reopen an escape route through the awakening volcano. Ashfang guards the final crossing.
mission.echoes_of_warning.title: Echoes of Warning
mission.echoes_of_warning.description: Answer three scout calls. Tap Scream for a short roar; hold it for a long roar.
mission.echoes_of_warning.intro: The volcano is waking up! Dinosaur scouts are calling across the valley. Answer their three patterns to coordinate the escape. Tap the Scream button for a short roar, or hold it for at least one second for a long roar. The symbols show you the pattern. A mistake only resets the current call.
mission.leap_of_fire.title: Leap of Fire
mission.leap_of_fire.description: Ride each rising basalt platform and jump onto the next ledge.
mission.leap_of_fire.intro: A lava gorge blocks the route. You are a nimble Velociraptor, so use Jump and Run to reach the rising basalt platforms. Ride each platform upward, then jump onto the next ledge. Complete all three jumps. A missed landing returns you to your last safe ledge.
mission.giants_balance.title: The Giant’s Balance
mission.giants_balance.description: Steady the slab at three marked balance points, then cross to the far side.
mission.giants_balance.intro: A huge slab has tipped across the route. Your Apatosaurus weight can steady it! Walk up the ramp and move to each glowing balance point. Hold still until the slab levels out, then continue. After all three points, cross down the far ramp. Stay away from the edges.
mission.black_wall.title: Break the Black Wall
mission.black_wall.description: Run straight at each weak spot and press Attack to charge it with your horns.
mission.black_wall.intro: An obsidian wall seals the passage. Your Triceratops horns can crack its three weak spots. Line up with a glowing crack, hold Run, and press Attack as you approach. A square hit breaks the wall; a glancing hit bounces off. Open all three sections, then pass through.
mission.return_to_sender.title: Return to Sender
mission.return_to_sender.description: Swing your tail when the landing circle turns green. Deflect five stones into the barriers.
mission.return_to_sender.intro: Small eruptions are throwing hot stones into your path. Stand in the marked landing circle and watch the approaching stone. When the circle turns green, press Attack to swing your Stegosaurus tail. The stone will fly into a brittle barrier. Deflect five stones to clear the route. If you miss, you can try again.
mission.ashfang.title: Ashfang, Lord of the Crater
mission.ashfang.description: Dodge Ashfang’s charges and sweeps. Attack during recovery, then reach the escape crossing.
mission.ashfang.intro: Ashfang, a giant T-Rex, guards the last crossing! As a Spinosaurus, dodge his marked charges and stay outside his tail sweep. Attack when he is stunned and the marker turns green. In the final phase, watch for glowing lava patches too. If he overwhelms you, retry the current phase. Defeat all three phases and follow the crossing to the green valley.
